viewing_check: Check each spoon for hallmarks (lion passant, town, date letter, maker) and which are plated (EPNS/brass showing); weigh the sterling ones; look at the shell caddy spoon mark and the gilt twist-stem spoon for any 800/830/84 Continental silver mark; note the damaged handle end.
